description: Display information about the contents of ELF format files.

option.name: --all
tip: Equivalent to -h -l -S -s -r -d -V -A -I --got-contents.

option.name: --arch-specific
tip: Display architecture-specific information.

option.name: --archive-index
tip: Display the symbol/file index in an archive.

option.name: --ctf
tip: Display CTF info from the section.

option.name: --ctf-parent
tip: Use the CTF archive member as the CTF parent.

option.name: --ctf-strings
tip: Use the section as the CTF external string table.

option.name: --ctf-symbols
tip: Use the section as the CTF external symbol table.

option.name: --debug-dir
tip: Search the directory for debug info files.

option.name: --debug-dump
tip: Display the contents of DWARF debug sections.

option.name: --decompress
tip: Decompress the section before dumping it.

option.name: --demangle
tip: Decode mangled or processed symbol names.
STYLE can be none, auto, gnu-v3, java, gnat, dlang or rust.

option.name: --display-section
tip: Display the contents of the indicated section; can be repeated.

option.name: --dwarf-depth
tip: Do not display DIEs at depth N or greater.

option.name: --dwarf-start
tip: Display DIEs starting at offset N.

option.name: --dyn-syms
tip: Display the dynamic symbol table.

option.name: --dynamic
tip: Display the dynamic section.

option.name: --extra-sym-info
tip: Display extra information when showing symbols.

option.name: --file-header
tip: Display the ELF file header.

option.name: --got-contents
tip: Display GOT section contents.

option.name: --headers
tip: Equivalent to -h -l -S.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this information.

option.name: --hex-dump
tip: Dump the contents of the section as bytes.

option.name: --histogram
tip: Display a histogram of bucket list lengths.

option.name: --lint
tip: Display warnings for possible problems.

option.name: --lto-syms
tip: Display LTO symbol tables.

option.name: --no-demangle
tip: Do not demangle low-level symbol names (default).

option.name: --no-extra-sym-info
tip: Do not display extra symbol information (default).

option.name: --no-recurse-limit
tip: Disable the demangling recursion limit.

option.name: --notes
tip: Display the contents of note sections.

option.name: --process-links
tip: Display non-debug sections in separate debuginfo files.

option.name: --program-headers
tip: Display the program headers.

option.name: --recurse-limit
tip: Enable a demangling recursion limit (default).

option.name: --relocated-dump
tip: Dump the relocated contents of the section.

option.name: --relocs
tip: Display the relocations.

option.name: --section-details
tip: Display the section details.

option.name: --section-groups
tip: Display the section groups.

option.name: --section-headers
tip: Display the section headers.

option.name: --sections
tip: An alias for --section-headers.

option.name: --segments
tip: An alias for --program-headers.

option.name: --sframe
tip: Display SFrame info from the named section (default .sframe).

option.name: --silent-truncation
tip: Do not add the [...] suffix when a symbol name is truncated.

option.name: --string-dump
tip: Dump the contents of the section as strings.

option.name: --sym-base
tip: Force the base for symbol sizes.
Possible values: 0, 8, 10, 16

option.name: --symbols
tip: An alias for --syms.

option.name: --syms
tip: Display the symbol table.

option.name: --unicode
tip: Display Unicode characters in the selected form.
Possible values: default, locale, escape, hex, highlight, invalid

option.name: --unwind
tip: Display the unwind info.

option.name: --use-dynamic
tip: Use dynamic section information when displaying symbols.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the version number of readelf.

option.name: --version-info
tip: Display the version sections.

option.name: --wide
tip: Allow the output width to exceed 80 characters.

option.name: -wk
tip: Display sections that link to separate debuginfo files.

option.name: -wK
tip: Follow links to separate debug info files (default).

option.name: -wN
tip: Do not follow links to separate debug info files.
